title: Diomedes recognizes Ares
intro: Diomedes recognizes Ares beside Hector and orders a controlled retreat. Ajax counters the Trojan advance.

notes.text: νοέω, notice: 3sg aor. στίξ, rank / row: acc pl; “along the ranks.”
ὄρνυμι, spring / rush: 3sg root aor mid.
κλάζω, shout / shriek: perf act ptc nom sg, present force. ἕπομαι, follow: 3pl impf.
Strong / close-packed ranks; φάλαγξ, line of battle, nom pl; not the later technical phalanx formation.
ἄρχω, lead: 3sg impf + dat σφιν, “them.” πότνια, lady / mistress; Enyo, a war goddess.
“Pitiless Tumult of battle”; κυδοιμός, din / confusion, personified; ἀναιδής, shameless / ruthless, acc sg; δηϊοτής, warfare, gen sg.
παλάμη, hand: dat pl. πελώριος, huge / monstrous. νωμάω, wield / ply: 3sg impf.
φοιτάω, move to and fro: unaugmented 3sg impf. “Now before Hector, now behind”; πρόσθε + gen.
ῥιγέω, shudder: 3sg aor. “Good at the war-cry”; βοή acc of respect.
Helpless / at a loss; literally without resource or means.
πολύς + πεδίον, gen sg; gen of space traversed, “across a broad plain.”
ἵστημι: epic 3sg root aor subj, “comes to a halt”; generalized simile after ὡς δ᾽ ὅτε.
ὠκύροος, swift-flowing: dat sg with ποταμῷ. ἅλα: acc sg of ἅλς, sea, destination; προρέω, flow onward, pres ptc dat sg.
“Seething with foam”; ἀφρός, foam: dat sg; μορμύρω, roar / surge: pres ptc acc sg, referring to the river.
τρέχω, run: 3sg 2aor, stem δραμ-; ἀνά + ὀπίσσω, “ran back again.” Aorist within the generalized simile.
ἀναχάζομαι, draw back: 3sg impf mid.
“How we marvelled that Hector was such a…”; ἔμεναι = εἶναι, epic pres inf; αἰχμητής, spearman; θαρσαλέος, bold.
πάρα = πάρεστι, “is beside him.” λοιγός, ruin / destruction; ἀμύνω, ward off.
“In the likeness of a mortal man”; ἔοικα, perf act ptc nom sg + dat.
τρέπω, turn: perf mid/pass ptc nom pl; πρὸς Τρῶας, “facing the Trojans.” Keep facing them while retreating.
εἴκω, yield / give ground: 2pl pres imperative.
μενεαίνω, be eager: epic pres inf used as imperative, “do not be eager to fight.” ἶφι, by force / with strength, old instrumental adv.
ἔρχομαι, come: 3pl epic 2aor, = ἦλθον. σχεδόν + gen, “close to them.”
φώς, warrior: acc dual; οἶδα perf ptc acc dual + gen; χάρμη, battle. “Two men skilled in battle.”
εἰν = ἐν; ἐόντε = ὄντε, pres ptc acc dual of εἰμί; the two occupy one chariot.
πεσόντε: acc dual 2aor ptc of πίπτω, “the fallen pair”; ἐλεέω, pity: 3sg aor.
ἵστημι, stand: unaugmented 3sg root aor. ἀκοντίζω, cast a spear: 3sg aor. φαεινός, shining.
ναίω, dwell: unaugmented 3sg impf. πολυκτήμων, rich in possessions; πολυλήϊος, rich in crops / cornland.
“Fate led him to serve as an ally”; ἑ acc sg pronoun; ἦγε impf of ἄγω; ἐπικουρέω fut ptc acc sg, purpose.
ζωστήρ, war-belt: acc sg; wound continues next page.
